excerpt: Agentic Commerce enables AI agents like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot to act on behalf of shoppers. For example, AI agents can find products, compare options, and make purchases.
You accept payments from shoppers who use AI agents and want to expose your product catalog or checkout process to those agents.
Integrate your AI agent platform with Adyen to securely tokenize shopper payment credentials and pass tokens to merchants.
Manage the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Manage the full Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Adyen stores the credential and returns an ACP token that your agent passes to the merchant. The merchant uses the token to process the payment with Adyen.
Adyen returns a UCP token that is associated with the specific checkout session and merchant identifier.
Adyen handles the communication with our merchants and the downstream complexity of orchestrating stock validation, tax calculation, shipping, and payment authorization.
Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.
Adyen communicates with your server so that you do not need to integrate with multiple agent platforms.
Cancel session (optional): Release reserved inventory when the shopper abandons checkout.
Commit session (optional): Run a final price or stock check before Adyen authorizes the payment.
The mapped data is synchronized with AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta. A single item can target multiple platforms in one request.
You upload product data in batches of up to 200 items.
shoppers can make complete transactions without leaving the interaction with your AI agent.
Use this integration for processing Google Pay payments through Adyen, when Google agents (Google AI Mode or Gemini) initiate transactions with you.
Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process
If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub.
Deliver a single product feed that automatically adapts to each AI platform's requirements, with accurate, real-time catalog and inventory data.
Convert high intent AI-powered discovery into checkout-ready carts, with live pricing, tax, and shipping synced at the point of selection.
Accept payments across all the major agentic protocols and channels while staying compliant, secure and fully in control.
Connect to AI platforms through a single integration that works with your existing order management and fulfillment systems. No rebuild required.
Customer approves payment. Transactions are screened for fraud and securely processed.
